# core/identity
**ADR:** `docs/adr/ADR-PROD-001-join-access-and-verify.md` — open signup + waitlist; Join is email → OTP → password; Verify carries `purpose`. Snapshot `join(email, password)` is superseded.
**Owns:** schema `auth.*` (user, session, account, verification, jwks, rateLimit) — generated by `npx @better-auth/cli generate`, migrated like any schema.
**Publishes:** `member.registered` (post-hook — outside Better Auth's transaction; `members.reconcileMissingProfiles` runs nightly), `member.deleted`.
**Consumes:** nothing.
**Ports:** `EmailSender` (integration/email), `EventPublisher` (platform).
**Facade:** `handler`, `getSession`, `requireMember`, `requireRole`, `deleteAccount`.
**Not in v1:** 2FA (TOTP/OTP), social login, admin dashboard, impersonation, avatars.
**Invariants tested:** recipient = user.email & awaited (email.test) · no dead guards + route inventory (guard.test) · register→verify→event exactly once + lockout (register.contract) · deletion = zero rows + tombstone (delete.test) · HIBP refusal (hibp.test) · per-route rate limits (ratelimit.test).
**Env:** BETTER_AUTH_SECRET (rotate per RUNBOOK), APP_ORIGIN, MOBILE_SCHEME, POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN (required in prod), REVIEW_ACCOUNT_*.
